Load libraries
```{r, message=FALSE}
library(Seurat)
library(Matrix)
library(dplyr)
```


Function to read each dataset
```{r}
read_10x_custom <- function(prefix) {
  mtx <- paste0(prefix, "_matrix.mtx")
  features <- paste0(prefix, "_features.tsv")
  barcodes <- paste0(prefix, "_barcodes.tsv")

  data <- readMM(mtx)
  genes <- read.delim(features, header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  cells <- read.delim(barcodes, header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

  rownames(data) <- genes[, 1]
  colnames(data) <- cells[, 1]
  
  return(data)
}

```


Read samples into a list (ages 0 - 5)

1623, 2975, 835, 2596, 4455 and A10895.
```{r}
data_dir <- "gene_expression_data"

samples <- c("HP1623_1", "HP1623_2", "HP2975_1", "HP2975_2", "HP835_1", "HP835_2", "HP2596_1", "HP2596_2", "HP4455_1", "HP4455_2", "HP4455_3", "HPA10895_1", "HPA10895_2")

data_list <- lapply(samples, function(s) read_10x_custom(file.path(data_dir, s)))

names(data_list) <- samples

```


Create Seurat objects
```{r}
seurat_list <- lapply(samples, function(s) {
  obj <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = data_list[[s]], project = s)
  return(obj)
})
names(seurat_list) <- samples

head((seurat_list[[1]]))
```


Read metadata into a list
```{r}
metadata_dir <- "childhood_hippocampus_snRNAseq_metadata"

# List all metadata files
meta_files <- list.files(metadata_dir, pattern = "_metadata.tsv$", full.names = TRUE)

# Extract sample IDs from file names
sample_ids <- gsub("_metadata.tsv$", "", basename(meta_files))

# Read all metadata into a list
metadata_list <- lapply(meta_files, function(f) {
  read.delim(f, header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, row.names = 1)
})

names(metadata_list) <- sample_ids

```


Add metadata to Seurat objects if available
```{r}
# Loop over your existing Seurat objects
seurat_list <- lapply(names(seurat_list), function(s) {
  seurat_obj <- seurat_list[[s]]
  
  if (s %in% names(metadata_list)) {
    meta <- metadata_list[[s]]
    common_cells <- intersect(colnames(seurat_obj), rownames(meta))
    if (length(common_cells) > 0) {
      seurat_obj <- AddMetaData(seurat_obj, metadata = meta[common_cells, , drop = FALSE])
    } else {
      warning(paste("No matching cells found for sample", s))
    }
  } else {
    warning(paste("No metadata found for sample", s))
  }
  
  return(seurat_obj)
})

# Keep the original Seurat names
names(seurat_list) <- names(data_list)  # or `names(seurat_list)` before lapply

head((seurat_list[[1]]))
table((seurat_list[[1]])$active.ident)
```

Rename from active.ident to cell_anno
```{r}
for (i in names(seurat_list)) {
  seurat_obj <- seurat_list[[i]]
  
  # Copy active.ident to a new column called 'cell_anno'
  seurat_obj$cell_anno <- seurat_obj$active.ident
  
  # Remove active.ident
  seurat_obj$active.ident <- NULL
  
  seurat_list[[i]] <- seurat_obj
}

head((seurat_list[[1]]))
table((seurat_list[[1]])$cell_anno)
```


Subset each Seurat object to remove doublet cells
```{r}
seurat_list <- lapply(seurat_list, function(seurat_obj) {
  # Keep only cells where cell_anno is NOT "doublet"
  seurat_obj <- subset(seurat_obj, subset = cell_anno != "doublet")
  return(seurat_obj)
})

head((seurat_list[[1]]))
table((seurat_list[[1]])$cell_anno)
```

Merge all Seurat objects.
```{r}
# Merge all objects in the list
combined <- merge(
  x = seurat_list[[1]],               # the first Seurat object
  y = seurat_list[-1],                # the rest of the list
  add.cell.ids = names(seurat_list),  # prepend sample IDs to cell names to keep them unique
  project = "Combined"
)

```


Check
```{r}
combined
table(combined$cell_anno)   # check cell type distribution
table(combined$orig.ident)  # check sample origin

```

Join layers
```{r}
combined <- JoinLayers(combined)

combined
table(combined$cell_anno)   # check cell type distribution
table(combined$orig.ident)  # check sample origin

```

Save
```{r}
saveRDS(combined, file = "Postnatal_human_seurat_v5.rds")
```


Subsample to include max 300 cells per cell type.
```{r}
library(dplyr)

meta <- combined@meta.data
meta$cell <- rownames(meta)  # keep cell names

set.seed(123)  # for reproducibility

cells_to_keep <- meta %>%
  group_by(cell_anno) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    n_cells <- nrow(.x)
    .x %>%
      slice_sample(n = ifelse(n_cells > 300, 300, n_cells))
  }) %>%
  pull(cell)

combined_sub <- subset(combined, cells = cells_to_keep)

table(combined_sub$cell_anno)
```

Save
```{r}
saveRDS(combined_sub, file = "Postnatal_human_seurat_v5_subset_300.rds")
```
